tagline: 宾得数码单反相机，2010 年发布
description: 宾得于2010年推出的数码单反相机。配备Interchangeable Pentax KAF3 and KAF2 mount compatible with Pentax auto-aperture lenses; older lenses supported in stop-down metering mode。快门速度30 – 1/8000 s, Bulb。

specs.镜头: Interchangeable Pentax KAF3 and KAF2 mount compatible with Pentax auto-aperture lenses; older lenses supported in stop-down metering mode
specs.存储: SD and SDHC; SDXC with firmware update 1.02 or later
specs.闪光灯: Onboard pop-up flash; hot shoe for P-TTL flash units with high-speed sync support; PC socket for studio flashes; 1/180 s X-sync speed
